newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu shares climb, helped by lower yen.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu shares climb, helped by lower yen.

text.p: Shares in Fujitsu Ltd climbed in heavy trade on Wednesday morning, helped by the yen's weakness against the dollar.
The major Japanese computer maker had gained 20 yen to 1,210 yen by 0041 GMT. Volume was 2.46 million shares, making it the second most active issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

"The further weakening of the yen against the dollar was encouraging for investors seeking blue chips and buying was centered around Fujitsu which has been popular lately," a trader at a middle-sized brokerage said.

A trader at a "Big Four" brokerage added that Fujitsu shares had been left behind in the bellwether issue shopping spree late last year and investors believed there was still room for its price to grow.
